# ECN-2026-040 - Change notice - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01

### Reason for change
This engineering change corrects and formalizes the maximum ring outer diameter allowed for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01). Recent production trials and maintenance inspections identified inconsistencies between operator practice, tooling documentation, and the machine controller parameter set. To eliminate ambiguity that has resulted in repeated setup delays and an increase in out-of-tolerance parts, the maximum permitted ring outer diameter is now specified as 1240 mm. This value aligns with the verified roll geometry and machine clearance confirmed during the verification activity documented in MM-P1-L1-RR01 and supports safe operation practices described in SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05.

Background and rationale
- During routine maintenance and a concurrent production verification, mill runout and edge contact margins were measured against tooling envelopes documented in MM-P1-L1-RR01. Measurements and clearances confirmed the safe operating envelope for the roll train and guard boundaries. To prevent recurrence of marginal setups that risk roll contact with guards and nonconforming rings, a single unequivocal outer diameter limit is required for all shift crews and engineering changes.
- Standard operating procedures SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05 will be updated to reflect the controlled maximum outer diameter. This prevents ad hoc increases during rush orders and ensures consistent QA acceptance criteria.

### Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01 — operational parameter controlling maximum ring outer diameter.
- Procedures: SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05 — operating and setup instructions that reference permissible workpiece sizes.
- Maintenance master record: MM-P1-L1-RR01 — machine verification and clearance documentation that supports the change.
- Operator setup sheets and inspection checklists used at P1-L1 — to be revised to include the specified maximum outer diameter and associated verification steps.

All references to maximum ring outer diameter within the above items must be revised to state exactly: 1240 mm. Any existing documents, labels, or digital parameter entries that currently show a different value must be corrected or annotated with a link to this ECN.

### Implementation
Scope
- Apply the change to the EQ-P1-L1-RR01 machine controller limits, setup templates, operator checklists, and departmental signage. Ensure the physical guarding and tooling envelope checks documented in MM-P1-L1-RR01 are appended to the machine's maintenance file.
- Update SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05 to include the certified maximum outer diameter and the mandatory verification method prior to first run of a lot and after any tooling change.

Action items and responsibilities
- Engineering: update the controller parameter and parameter log for EQ-P1-L1-RR01 to reflect the maximum permitted outer diameter of 1240 mm and record the change in MM-P1-L1-RR01. Verify that controller interlocks will prevent entry of dimensions exceeding 1240 mm.
- Operations: revise the operator setup sheets and ensure all operators acknowledge the change. Train operators on the verification procedure documented in SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05; training records must be retained.
- Maintenance: perform a verification inspection of roll clearance and guards per MM-P1-L1-RR01, and record measurements and findings in the machine history file. Apply physical labels at the machine ingress point indicating the maximum outer diameter as 1240 mm.
- Quality: update incoming inspection and final inspection checklists to reference the maximum permissible outer diameter and ensure sampling plans include verification against the new limit.

Verification and records
- Prior to production re-start, engineering will run a verification routine to confirm the machine enforces the 1240 mm limit. Results and the controller snapshot will be filed in MM-P1-L1-RR01.
- Operations training attendance and competency sign-off will be recorded against operator personnel files and a copy retained with the EQ-P1-L1-RR01 run folder.
- Maintenance inspection forms and any corrective actions shall be logged in the equipment maintenance record and cross-referenced to MM-P1-L1-RR01.
- SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05 revision notes will cite this ECN and note the date of implementation.

Examples and practitioner notes
- Example scenario: For a workpiece scheduled with target outer diameter approaching tooling limits, the setup operator must verify the nominal outer diameter and final expected outer diameter do not exceed 1240 mm before mounting. If nominal or expected final metric exceeds 1240 mm, the job must be escalated to engineering for alternate processing.
- Example documentation practice: When a tooling change is performed that could affect the envelope, maintenance shall perform the clearance check and append the signed MM-P1-L1-RR01 inspection sheet to the machine history. This sheet must include a statement confirming clearance for a maximum outer diameter of 1240 mm.

Transition plan
- Affected documents SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05 will be revised concurrently with this ECN and released with change notices linking to this ECN. MM-P1-L1-RR01 shall be updated with the verification evidence.
- Implementation start will be the date on which approvals below are completed and recorded. No production batches that have potential outer diameters exceeding 1240 mm shall be processed on EQ-P1-L1-RR01 after that approval.

### Approvals
- This ECN requires documented approval by engineering, operations management, and maintenance management. Approval signatures and dates will be recorded in the document control system and copies attached to MM-P1-L1-RR01 and the revised SOPs.

Referenced documents
- MM-P1-L1-RR01
- SOP-P1-L1-01
- SOP-P1-L1-05

Records to keep
- Controller parameter snapshot for EQ-P1-L1-RR01 reflecting the 1240 mm limit.
- MM-P1-L1-RR01 verification and clearance inspection sheets.
- Operator training sign-offs and updated setup sheets.
- Revised SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05 with revision notes linking to this ECN.

End of notice.
